blocking_conditions: missing or stale actual input hash
PIT/scanner projection not reproduced for the configured pool and stream cap
first decision lacks 23 completed daily bars
any candidate change beyond ranking score

candidate.score_definition: MAX_i(P_i / P_{i-1} - 1) for the last 22 completed daily returns, using 23 consecutive completed daily bars; sort ascending score, then symbol
candidate.signal: rank the maximum of the last 22 single-day simple returns in ascending order; the lowest MAX score ranks first

controls: crypto_low_variance_hysteresis_v1 same pool, cadence, top_n, equal weights, retention rank and risk contract

evaluation_windows.native_96h_schedule_anchor: 2021-04-01T00:00:00Z; fixed UTC elapsed grid at +96h, independent of missing daily buckets
evaluation_windows.schedule_gap_rule: missing daily buckets do not advance or compress the 96h grid

inputs.aggregation: existing complete 1h to 1d path; no forward fill

native_projection_contract.candidate_observation_basis: candidate-owned observed symbols capped at 12 from the common PIT pool
native_projection_contract.context_source: reviewed native PortfolioContext projection; no PortfolioBacktestEngine.run in novelty mode
native_projection_contract.daily_bar_visibility: a UTC daily bucket is visible only after bucket_end (label + 24 hours) has passed as_of
native_projection_contract.incumbent_observation_basis: same as-of snapshot key and common PIT pool, independently traced
native_projection_contract.pairing: candidate and incumbent contexts must have identical decision timestamp and snapshot key
native_projection_contract.virtual_holdings: previous targets only to exercise inherited retention rank 4; no fills, PnL, or costs

novelty_gate.archive_search: No MAX-return, lottery, or max-daily-return signal implementation/result found in searched scripts, archive, docs, or research artifacts.
novelty_gate.comparison_required: paired raw-score overlap against incumbent before any economics
novelty_gate.near_duplicate_rule: NO_ECONOMIC_RUN if median Spearman >= 0.95 AND raw top-2 identical fraction >= 0.90
novelty_gate.primary_full_samples: full evaluation window only, same as-of and snapshot keys
novelty_gate.recent_slice: 2024-01-01..2026-07-31 descriptive replay slice; no independent reset or gate
novelty_gate.undefined_or_invalid_pair_rule: exclude with serialized reason; never coerce to zero

output_policy: new isolated attempt_02_trace_complete; retain R4 artifacts immutable; no economic engine/PnL/fills/costs
purpose: Pre-economic novelty and data-feasibility registration; no score measurement or economic run is authorized by this file.

review.scope: technical raw trace persistence only; formula, ordering, hysteresis, eligibility, cadence, windows and thresholds unchanged

trace_requirements.technical_review: written JSON and clean module subprocess raw top2 audit passed

universe_contract.universe_mode: configured pool plus existing PIT/scanner availability; stream cap is an observation constraint, not an alpha feature
